# HealthOS

HealthOS is an academic project for the NT208 course at UIT (University of Information Technology, VNU-HCM), Vietnam.
The site is a demo for health management features: BMI/calorie tracking, AI meal recognition, medication reminders, vitals logging.

Canonical: https://healthos.io.vn

## Public pages
- https://healthos.io.vn/vi
- https://healthos.io.vn/en

- https://healthos.io.vn/en/services
- https://healthos.io.vn/vi/plans
- https://healthos.io.vn/en/plans
- https://healthos.io.vn/vi/articles
- https://healthos.io.vn/en/articles

## Not for indexing
- Dashboard, admin, onboarding, and auth pages are gated and not intended for crawl.

## Notes
This is a student project. Content is educational and does not constitute medical advice.
